verdict.rationale: Groq is API-first. It documents an OpenAI-compatible REST API at a public base URL, with Chat Completions and Responses APIs, batch processing, an official TypeScript SDK, a deprecations policy and a subscribable API changelog. An AI-native user can clearly drive it programmatically. Missing for 10: a standalone downloadable OpenAPI spec (it is only embedded in the reference page source, and candidate spec paths return 404), and any documented versioning beyond the fixed /openai/v1 path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: To start using Groq with OpenAI's client libraries, pass your Groq API key to the api_key parameter and change the base_url to https://api.groq.com/openai/v1
This library provides convenient access to the Groq REST API from server-side TypeScript or JavaScript.
Generating text with Groq's Chat Completions API enables you to have natural, conversational interactions with Groq's large language models.
Process large-scale workloads asynchronously with our Batch API
A reverse-chronological API changelog with RSS and email subscription
